passages.sermon: David wrote this.\r\nDavid was the author.\r\nDavid spoke these words.

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
passages.sermon:
David speaks these words.
The LORD is my Rock.
The LORD deserves blessing.
The LORD trains my hands for war.
The LORD trains my fingers for battle.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my steadfast love.
The LORD is my fortress.
The LORD is my stronghold.
The LORD is my deliverer.
The LORD is my shield.
I take refuge in the LORD.
The LORD subdues peoples under me.
passages.original: חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֪י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּב֣וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָרוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃

passages.text: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
God is great and powerful.
God knows all things.
God sees every person.
What is a human being?
Why does God pay attention to a person?
What is the son of man?
Why does God think about him?
God cares for people, even though they are small.
God thinks about each person.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מָה־ אָ֭דָם וַתֵּדָעֵ֑הוּ בֶּן־ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ וַֽתְּחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
passages.sermon:
Man is like a breath.
His life is brief.
His days pass quickly.
His days are like a shadow that moves and disappears.
passages.original: אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר׃

passages.text: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD rules over heaven and earth.
LORD, open the skies.
LORD, come down to us.
LORD, touch the mountains.
The mountains will smoke when You touch them.
passages.original: יְ֭הוָה הַט־ שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

passages.text: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
passages.sermon:
God, You have great power.
Send out Your lightning.
Make the lightning flash.
Scatter Your enemies with it.
Shoot out Your arrows.
Defeat and confuse them with Your arrows.
passages.original: בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃

passages.text: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and mighty.
God is above all things.
God, reach down from Your high place.
Set me free.
Rescue me from deep waters.
Save me from the power of foreigners.
These foreigners speak lies with their mouths.
Their right hands are full of deceit.
passages.original: שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִמָּ֫ר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־ שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You— to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
passages.sermon:
God, I will sing a new song to You.
I will praise You with a harp of ten strings.
You give victory to kings.
You set Your servant David free from the deadly sword.
passages.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑ךְ בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־ לָּֽךְ׃ הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַמְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭פּוֹצֶה אֶת־ דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדּ֗וֹ מֵחֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
passages.sermon:
God, you have power to save.
Set me free.
Rescue me from the power of foreigners.
These foreigners speak lies with their mouths.
Their right hands act with deceit.
passages.original: פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֪ד בְּֽנֵי־ נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־ שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the blessings God gives to His people.
God blesses families.
Our sons will grow strong.
They will be like young plants.
These plants are well cared for.
Our daughters will be beautiful and strong.
They will be like pillars at the corners of a palace.
These pillars are carefully carved.
They make the palace beautiful.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ׀ כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֪ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃

passages.text: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
passages.sermon:
David praises God in this psalm.
Our storehouses will be full.
They will supply every kind of produce.
Our flocks will give birth to thousands.
Tens of thousands of animals will fill our fields.
passages.original: מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־ זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
passages.sermon:
The people are safe and secure.
Our oxen carry heavy loads.
No enemy breaks through our walls.
No one goes into captivity.
No one cries out in sorrow in our streets.
passages.original: אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־ פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The people who have these blessings are happy.
The people whose God is the LORD are happy.
God gives these people joy.
The LORD is their God.
These people receive His blessings.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֶׁיֲהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
